title: Locket
lyrics:
[00:56.21]I live in a house with a tin roof and
[01:01.08]Every time it rains, I can feel my brain
[01:05.36]It's moving back and forth
[01:08.36]Upside down, east-west
[01:10.81]Feeling and remembering everything you do
[01:25.28]I was up last night tossing and turning
[01:30.10]Couldn't get to sleep and I slept thru the morning
[01:35.00]Need to clear my head and get out of the city
[01:39.88]All alone in the jungle you'll find me
[01:44.75]Close your eyes and hear my secret
[01:50.04]Deep, deep love and hear my secret
[01:55.37]Hear my secret, hear my secret
[02:10.28]Sometimes I can hear the tremble below me
[02:15.26]Pounding thru the floor, my body so restless
[02:19.91]It lives in the basement below some boxes
[02:24.93]Makes me feel so strange and so thoughtless, so
[02:29.82]Maybe someday this roof will cave in
[02:34.06]You'll find me on the floor looking at the stars
[02:38.84]These walls are made of brick, plated in gold
[02:43.65]But I'm still here growing so old
[02:49.16]Close your eyes and hear my secret
[02:54.43]Deep, deep love and hear my secret
[02:59.64]Hear my secret, hear my secret
[03:04.81]Close your eyes and hear my secret
[03:10.06]Deep, deep love and hear my secret
[03:15.32]Hear my secret, hear my secret
